# v0.1.12 legacy NetCDF fixture

`data/v0.1.12-legacy.nc` is a fixed regression fixture for reading the
unversioned NetCDF files emitted by the v0.1.12 codebase.  It is intentionally
versioned, unlike the disposable test data generated by
`generate_fixtures.py`.

## Provenance

- Source revision: annotated tag `v0.1.12` (`7ded3b0f9737d46cd9fd67dc53124019dec1e4d6`)
- Generator: `tests/fixtures/generate_fixtures.py:generate_netcdf4`
- Generation command:
  `conda run -n gwexpy python -c "from tests.fixtures.generate_fixtures import generate_netcdf4; generate_netcdf4('/tmp/gwexpy-v0112-legacy.nc')"`
- Python: 3.11.14
- xarray: 2026.2.0
- netCDF4: 1.7.4
- HDF5: 1.14.6
- SHA-256: `3ccc0cf0cb7baf444c9f90b91d98c32f24c9880fd0d2987af1a105c457911082`
- Content review: deterministic synthetic channel `ch1`; no detector data,
  personal data, credentials, or third-party content.  The fixture is covered
  by this repository's MIT license.

## `ncdump -h`

```text
netcdf v0.1.12-legacy {
dimensions:
        time = 100 ;
variables:
        double time(time) ;
                time:long_name = "GPS time" ;
                time:units = "s" ;
        float ch1(time) ;
                ch1:t0 = 1704067200. ;
                ch1:dt = 0.1 ;
}
```
